name: Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card

welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 125,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $5,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: 2026-09-09 issuer recheck: 50,000 Bonus Miles plus 2 round-trip Delta Comfort Flight Certificates after $10,000/6 months, ending November 4, 2026.
Previous public limited-time 7/15/2026 offer was removed from current production values to avoid displaying an expired offer.
Post-7/15/2026 closeout completed: expired limited-time Delta Amex state removed/confirmed; current production state is this welcome_offer block.

2026-11-09 official Amex product page GET 200 (full HTML incl. embedded JSON): "Earn 70,000 100,000 Bonus Miles after you use your new Card to make $5,000 in purchases within the first 6 months. This offer may not be available if you leave this web page and return later." Welcome offer synced 50,000 + 2 Comfort Flight Certificates / $10,000 / 6 months -> 100,000 / $5,000 / 6 months; 'Comfort Flight' no longer appears anywhere in the official welcome-offer copy, so companion_certificates removed from welcome_offer. Post-renewal Annual Companion Certificate (other_benefits) still official and kept. Expired Nov 4 language and expires_at removed. estimated_value 500 -> 1000 (1 cent/mile, same as Gold/Platinum).

2026-11-16 as-high-as policy (lead decision after #95/#100): official Amex product-page content API (GET 200, 9:32:32 AM PST; this is the cardshop payload the product page loads — the visible product page returned a 'Loading Error' shell from the same fetcher) solicitationOffer: "AS HIGH AS 125,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $5,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." The same payload also has a baseline welcomeOffer "Earn 70,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $5,000 in purchases on your new Card in your first 6 months of Card Membership." Annual fee $650. No 'Offer ends' date; offer.specialInd is N; no limited-time/increased-offer flag. delta.com personal-cards page (rendered GET 200, 9:29:51–9:30:20 AM PST): hero "APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS 125,00 BONUS MILES After you make $5,000 in eligible purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Memberships. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." (the page text literally says 125,00 and 'Memberships'; Amex says 125,000). The same delta.com comparison table still lists "Two Delta Comfort Tickets + 50,000 Miles" for Reserve; treated as a stale leftover and not applied. The 'as high as' 125,000 amount is targeted/variable, so it is not stored as a fixed bonus: bonus_points 100000 -> 0 with bonus_value 'Varies', bonus_points_max 125000, estimated_value 1000 removed, offer_status public_limited_time -> as_high_as_ymmv, is_elevated true -> false (decided from current official copy, which has no elevated/limited-time language). Spend/months unchanged ($5,000 / 6 months, stated as fixed terms on both official sources).
source_conflicts: delta.com personal-cards hero typo 'AS HIGH AS 125,00 BONUS MILES' and comparison-table leftover 'Two Delta Comfort Tickets + 50,000 Miles' conflict with the official Amex product content API ('AS HIGH AS 125,000 Bonus Miles' / $5,000 / 6 months, no companion certificates in the welcome offer); Amex + the delta.com hero 'as high as' language are used, and the table leftover is not applied.

lounge_access.name: Delta Sky Club
lounge_access.discount: 15 visits per year to Delta Sky Club when flying Delta; unlimited visits after spending $75,000 in a calendar year. Also receives complimentary access to The Centurion Lounge and Escape Lounges when flying Delta. 4 One-Time Guest Passes per Medallion Year.

other_benefits.name: Companion Certificate
other_benefits.description: Annual companion certificate valid for a First Class, Delta Comfort+, or Main Cabin round-trip flight to select destinations after renewal. Taxes/fees of $22-$250 apply.

other_benefits.name: MQD Headstart
other_benefits.description: $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars each Medallion Qualification Year.

other_benefits.name: MQD Boost
other_benefits.description: Earn $1 MQD for each $10 in purchases on the card (stronger than Platinum tier).

other_benefits.name: Free Checked Bag
other_benefits.description: First checked bag free for you and up to 8 companions on Delta flights.

other_benefits.name: Priority Boarding
other_benefits.description: Zone 5 priority boarding on Delta flights.

other_benefits.name: 15% Off Award Travel
other_benefits.description: 15% off when using miles to book Award Travel on Delta flights.

other_benefits.name: Upgrade Priority
other_benefits.description: Upgrade priority over others with the same Medallion tier, product, and fare experience.

other_benefits.name: Clear Discount
other_benefits.description: Discount on Clear+ membership based on SkyMiles status.

other_benefits.name: Second Checked Bag Free
other_benefits.description: Second checked bag free on domestic Delta-operated flights for eligible Basic Delta SkyMiles Gold, Platinum, and Reserve Card Members; terms apply.

other_benefits.name: Companion Certificate for Delta Vacations
other_benefits.description: Companion Certificate can now be redeemed toward the eligible flight portion of a Delta Vacations package; terms apply.

insurance.notes: Strong travel protections including trip cancellation/interruption. Trip delay requires delay >12 hours.

recurring_credits.name: Resy Credit
recurring_credits.description: $20/month ($240/year) at US Resy restaurants or eligible Resy purchases.

recurring_credits.name: Rideshare Credit
recurring_credits.description: $10/month ($120/year) on US rideshare with select providers (Uber, Lyft, Curb, Revel, Alto).

recurring_credits.name: Delta Stays Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $200/year on prepaid hotels via Delta Stays on delta.com.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.
